MEN-01.notas: Forty-something, former alarm technician. Chain-smokes. He opened Helen's door and copied the drive in the car.
MEN-01.nota: MEN-01 is Lonnie Barras per the records in docs 11 and 14 (the newest). Doc 01 (and docs 03, 06, and 10, which talk about “the MEN-01 crew”) used it for the whole crew of thieves; doc 14 wins.

MEN-02.notas:
Ex-military and former federal agents. Hired as a “special counterterrorism unit.” They think they know what they're hunting. Most of them have never seen it.

**Gear:** short carbine with incendiary ammunition (aggravated against Kindred), weapon-mounted UV flashlight, light body armor (armor 3), body camera, radio, thermal goggles (negate Obfuscate levels 1 and 2).

**Tactics:** they never go in alone. Always in pairs, always with a drone overhead and a light source behind them. If they lose two operators, they pull back and wait for dawn.

MEN-11.concepto: MEN-02 operator, Bear's former SEAL teammate
MEN-11.notas:
Forty-nine, mustache, knees wrecked like Bear's. He thinks he works for Homeland Security. Absolute loyalty to his teammates, and Bear was one of them.

Uses the stats of @ID[MEN-02], with **Insight 6** to notice that Bear doesn't limp anymore. (See @ID[GAN-04].)

MEN-03.notas:
Ex-military and ex-cops who live in trailers behind the barn. They know Montgomery as “the Boss.” They don't ask questions.

**Gear:** shotguns, hunting rifles, pickup trucks.
MEN-03.nota: MEN-03 is the group of six bounty hunters (doc 14, newest record). Doc 08 assigned it to Dutch Lindqvist alone; doc 14 wins, and it gives Dutch his own pools within MEN-03.

MEN-03-DUTCH.concepto: The oldest of Montgomery's bounty hunters
MEN-03-DUTCH.notas: The oldest, sixty. He's been with Montgomery for twenty years and is starting to wonder what exactly his boss is. Uses the same stats as @ID[MEN-03] with **Insight 5**. If the coterie wins him over (@tirada{attributes.charisma+skills.persuasion|3|Charisma + Persuasion (Difficulty 3)}), he warns them when Montgomery gives the order to hunt them down (@ID[A3-E04]).
MEN-03-DUTCH.nota: No ID of his own in the docs: doc 14 places him within MEN-03 “with his own pools” (doc 08 assigned him MEN-03). Derived ID for the actor.

PERROS-MONTGOMERY.notas:
Shepherds and wolf crosses. They sense Montgomery's will and the Beast of any Kindred within fifty meters.

**Attack** 6 (bite, +1 damage) · **Defense** 5 · **Tracking** 8 · **Health** 5 · They act as a pack: each additional dog adds +1 die to the first one's attack, up to +3.

MEN-04.concepto: Four in total; two go with Dawson
MEN-04.nota: MEN-04 is the “Dawson and the security ghouls” entry in doc 14 (newest record). Doc 11 assigned it to Dawson alone and doc 01 to Gale's security ghouls; doc 14 wins. This actor carries the pools for the four ghouls; Dawson goes in MEN-04-DAWSON.

MEN-04-DAWSON.notas:
The boss. Ex-Marine, bull neck, supernatural sense of smell. He's the one who sniffed out Helen's stairwell and took the drive from Lonnie.

**Awareness 6 (smell):** detects Kindred within 20 meters, ignores Obfuscate unless the wind is against him.

**Disciplines:** Potence 1 (Lethal Body), Auspex 1 (Heightened Senses) · **Blood Bond** to Halloway, level 2 (+2 dice to resist).

**Gear:** pistols, extendable batons, vests (armor 2), radios.
MEN-04-DAWSON.nota: No ID of his own in doc 14: he's the boss within MEN-04, with his own pools (doc 11 assigned him MEN-04). Derived ID for the actor.

MEN-09.notas:
Ninety-six years old, looks sixty. Polite, sad, meticulous. He typed up Vance's journals and knows where every one of his master's papers is.

**Blood Bond** to Halloway, level 3 (+3 dice to resist others' Disciplines).
MEN-09.nota: Editor's Note: doc 14 said “since 1950,” before Halloway's Embrace (1958); 1958 was chosen. The 96 years and the appearance of 60 stay (he was made a ghoul at 28).

PNJ-10.concepto: Halloway's childe (only if nobody plays Celeste Arden)
PNJ-10.notas:
Looks thirty-something, corporate lawyer Embraced in 2009. He fills Celeste's role (@ID[PJ-02]): he signs for the Cascade Holdings accounts and is the Council's scapegoat. He knows less than he thinks.

**If he's accused at the Council:** he falls apart. A @tirada{attributes.charisma+skills.persuasion|2|Charisma + Persuasion (Difficulty 2)} roll convinces him to testify against Halloway (+2 dice to the case).

MEN-05.concepto: About fifteen Kindred: longshoremen, mechanics, a nurse, two thin-bloods
MEN-05.notas:
Longshoremen, mechanics, a nurse, two thin-bloods. They vote every Friday. Use these pools for anyone unnamed.

**Disciplines:** Potence 1 or Celerity 1 (one or the other, Storyteller's choice).
MEN-05.nota: MEN-05 is the Salt's Anarchs group (doc 14, newest record). Doc 08 used it for Bas Okonjo and Tavi Mercer as named members; doc 14 wins, and it gives them their own pools within MEN-05.

MEN-05-BAS.notas: He fears Montgomery more than anything.
MEN-05-BAS.nota: No ID of his own in doc 14: a member of MEN-05 with his own pools (doc 08 put him under MEN-05). Derived ID for the actor.

MEN-05-TAVI.notas: If he attacks Elysium, he does it with three comrades and Molotov cocktails.
MEN-05-TAVI.nota: No ID of his own in doc 14: a member of MEN-05 with his own pools (doc 08 put him under MEN-05). Derived ID for the actor.

MEN-13.concepto: SoDo fence (dies on Night 4 if nobody steps in)
MEN-13.notas: Seventy, former antiques dealer. Buys and sells to clients who only come out at night, and doesn't ask why. *Dies on @reloj{4} if nobody steps in.*

MEN-14.concepto: Caitiff, Sal's protector (destroyed on Night 4 if nobody steps in)
MEN-14.notas: Former nightclub bouncer Embraced in 2011. Guards the warehouse in exchange for bagged blood and a corner to sleep in. *Destroyed on @reloj{4} if nobody steps in.*

MEN-06.notas: Forty, three kids. He saw Krell destroy Pike (@ID[MEN-12]) from the cab. He's sure of what he saw.

MEN-07.concepto: Fill-in pathologist at the medical examiner's office
MEN-07.notas: Thirty-eight, a recent hire, very conscientious. He did his job right on case 26-3307, and that's the problem.

MEN-10.concepto: Survivor of Emily's night (1996), youth counselor
MEN-10.notas: Survivor of Emily's night (1996), youth counselor (@ID[GAN-01]).

MEN-08.notas:
Former Sabbat Kindred (@ID[GAN-09]). Nobody knows his name. He's spent twelve years in the Tacoma storm drains, feeding carefully. Old, patient, deformed by the 2014 fire. He visits the Larchmont cistern barefoot.

**Disciplines:** Obfuscate 3, Protean 2 (Feral Weapons), Fortitude 2.

**Tactics:** he never fights in the open. He flees toward the water and waits.

MEN-12.concepto: Nosferatu runner for the Moles, destroyed on Night 2
MEN-12.notas: Minor Nosferatu, runner for the Moles. He had just received a partial copy of the File from Jun Takeda for a buyer when Krell destroyed him beside a red shipping container at Terminal 46, on @reloj{2}, between 2:00 and 3:00 a.m. (@ID[A1-E02]).
